iWantTo: the inventory_code column to be dropped from the schema after backfill
soThat: the end-state schema carries only the split batch and serial columns.

independence.rationale: Dropping the column is independently observable and testable from backfilling. The code can add and backfill batch/serial while inventory_code remains present (confirmed via schema diff), so the drop is a distinct outcome that can be reversed independently via the down-migration.
